purpose: Publish the single official Skin Stage 2 relation consumer surface after full Stage 1 upstream parity has been proven, so downstream Skin/Hero consumers read frozen derived indexes instead of recalculating ownership or ordering from ConfigData or intermediate relation artifacts.

bySkinId.cardinality: EXACTLY_ONE for every canonical regular Hero skin
bySkinId.useFor: Resolve a canonical regular Hero skin to its owner Hero and frozen source order.

byHeroId.emptyEntryRule: All canonical Heroes are present; the 32 Heroes without regular skins have an explicit empty array.
byHeroId.orderingRule: Array order is frozen Stage 1 sourceOrder. Consumers must preserve the stored order and must not sort by skinId or any alternate field.
byHeroId.useFor: Resolve a canonical Hero to the complete ordered list of regular Hero skins.

consumerRules: The official runtime/research relation source is data/generated/skin-stage2-3-bidirectional-relation.v1.json; downstream consumers must not combine Stage 2-1 and Stage 2-2 themselves.

Do not read ConfigDataHeroInfo.Skins_ID[], ConfigDataHeroSkinInfo.SpecifiedHero, Hero Stage 5-5, or Skin Stage 1 canonical as a fallback relation calculator when the Stage 2 consumer relation is present.
Do not infer Hero ownership from skin names, filenames, asset paths, resource IDs, acquisition metadata or numeric skinId patterns.
Do not sort by skinId, Score, UISort, release state, acquisition category, filename or asset path; preserve the stored byHeroId array order.
Do not omit zero-skin Heroes from Hero-keyed consumers; an empty byHeroId array is an authoritative ZERO result, not missing data.
JSON object keys are serialized strings; consumers convert numeric heroId/skinId lookup keys to strings without changing the underlying integer identity.
Stage 2 relation indexes contain relation identity/order only and must not be treated as authorities for release state, localization, acquisition enrichment, asset extraction/export or displayTarget.

allowed: Skin-domain code may use bySkinId to join skin records to canonical Hero identity.
Hero-domain code may use byHeroId to retrieve the complete ordered regular-skin list, including explicit empty arrays.
Later stages may join release, localization, acquisition or asset metadata by skinId without altering Stage 2 owner/order semantics.
notProvidedByStage2: CN/KR release state or KR_FUTURE eligibility
asset extraction, conversion or web-export path

reopenOnlyWhen: An authoritative correction changes the accepted Stage 1 canonical skinId population, heroId ownership or sourceOrder.
The accepted Hero Stage 5-5 to Skin Stage 1 parity chain is formally corrected upstream.
A generation/serialization defect is proven in the Stage 2 relation artifacts.
doNotReopenFor: release/localization/acquisition/asset metadata updates that do not change owner or sourceOrder
new speculative relations inferred from names, files or numeric patterns

completionRule: Skin Stage 2 completes only when Stage 2-0 through Stage 2-4 are PASS, the official bidirectional consumer relation is ACCEPTED with 540 bySkinId keys, 267 byHeroId keys and 540 edges, all consumer value shapes/cardinalities are valid, 32 zero-skin Heroes remain explicit empty arrays, and the official no-recalculation/no-resort consumer rules are frozen.
nextAction: Skin Stage 3: inventory/extract/export/map Skin assets using the frozen Stage 2 relation indexes for ownership/order joins without reopening ConfigData relation semantics.
